classification.difficultyReason: Include the host, convert the total drink requirement to litres, and round the number of bottles upwards to provide enough.

content.prompt:
Samantha is inviting 18 friends to a party.
She estimates that each person will drink 700 mL of soft drink.

children.label: a
children.prompt: How many litres of soft drink does she need to buy?

answer.worked:
Including Samantha, there are $19$ people.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Drink required} &= 19\times700\text{ mL}\\\text{Drink required} &= 13\,300\text{ mL}\\\text{Drink required} &= 13.3\text{ L}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: If each large bottle of soft drink is 2.5 L, how many bottles does she need?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Bottles required} &= 13.3\div2.5\\\text{Bottles required} &= 5.32\end{align*}$$
She needs 6 whole bottles to have enough soft drink.
